primary_metrics.G_normalized_cost: equal-tier failure-inclusive attempts divided by the fixed instance horizon

scopes: per instance and condition; average Lights Out instances within family, then five families equally; keep conditions separate
unsupported: null, not zero; no all-core summary for controls declared on only a subset of families
failed_runs: retain every registered fit/evaluation; supported scores zero, normalized goal cost one; never impute unobserved actions or latency

uncertainty.outer: resample the three registered data-seed IDs with replacement as shared clusters across fixed tasks
uncertainty.inner: within each sampled outer cluster independently resample three fit-seed IDs with replacement
uncertainty.pairing: identical draws for every method, coverage, query budget and fixed task
uncertainty.deterministic_controls: broadcast over fit-seed axis for paired contrasts; no fictitious additional runs
uncertainty.conditioning: fixed task families, instances, cases, partitions, selected configurations and training budget
uncertainty.limitations: three outer seeds; intervals are descriptive, not calibrated evidence of significance or unseen-family generalization

prespecified_contrasts: all pairwise primary learned series at full coverage: GCBC/0, GCIQL/0, dynamics/32, dynamics/128
full minus 25 percent and full minus 50 percent coverage within each matching method/budget
128 minus 32 queries within each matching model-based method/coverage
matched bounded oracle dynamics minus learned dynamics at full coverage and equal query budget
optimal oracle minus bounded oracle at each registered budget
costs: all original/retry attempts once; worker elapsed work separate from experiment wall time; unknown crash cost marked missing; archive reproduction cost separate
case_evidence: all G case records plus R/C prediction archives checked against saved metrics; unavailable evaluations retain expected case denominator
selection: no additional hyperparameter/checkpoint/seed choice from these statistics
interpretation: no pooled R/C/G scalar, no significance threshold, no selective best-budget or best-seed headline
